title: Transaction Processing & Indexing
description:
Get transactions flowing through the system and verify indices are correctly updated.

Work Items:
1. Indexer Subscriber Integration - Implement Subscriber trait for Indexer to receive transactions from log
2. Node::execute_tx() Implementation - Synchronous tx execution using existing await_tx() method  
3. Node::submit_tx() Implementation - Async fire-and-forget tx submission
4. Integration Tests - End-to-end tests proving tx flow

Key Implementation Notes:
- Indexer ALREADY HAS synchronization via broadcast channel (await_tx method exists!)
- No need for atomic counters - use existing tx_completion_sender broadcast
- No need to wrap HashMap in Arc<RwLock> - Indexer is already behind RwLock
- await_tx() future doesn't borrow self, perfect for RwLock usage

Success Criteria: 
- execute_tx successfully transacts and waits for indexing completion
- submit_tx returns immediately without waiting
- All 5 indices (EAV, AVE, AEV, AE, AV) populated correctly
- Put, Add, Retract operations work end-to-end
- Transaction ordering preserved
- Errors logged appropriately
